meta.name: T flip-flop
meta.description: Each rising edge of the input moves a redstone block one step between two pistons, toggling the lamp. The sticky piston under the input block cuts each input to a short pulse. After the Bedrock piston T flip-flop on minecraft.wiki (Redstone circuits/Memory/TFF Piston Bedrock), with a lever and a lamp added.

annotations.text: Pulse limiter: when the input rises it lifts the block feeding the first repeater, so each press sends one short pulse.
The redstone block shuttles between z=2 and z=3; at z=3 it lights the lamp.
Dust under the stack: powered only when a block sits above it, so only the piston facing the stack fires.
Timing: this repeater's pulse must end before the stack lands at z=4, or the other piston fires straight back. Build this example first at M3.
